MAN 01 — About

Noble works at the point where hospitality operations and AI-native content production meet.

He's a Tourism & Hospitality Management undergraduate at World University of Bangladesh, currently producing AI-generated visuals and short-form video as an AI UGC Creator for Lovora, a relationship and couple-activities app. The role covers everything from AI content generation and trend research to publishing across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook, and reading the engagement data that follows.

That production instinct comes from the same place as his hospitality training: since 2024 he has served as Associate & Official Volunteer, Team Lead with the URE Race Crew Team, leading operational support at large-scale motorsport events in Dhaka — supervising volunteers, coordinating vendors, and resolving problems on-site under time pressure. He's carried that coordination background through campus leadership at BAF Shaheen College's Business Club, active involvement with the WUB THM Club, and freelance photography and cinematography since 2024.

He's also founded Trendzo Mart, an e-commerce venture in gadgets and trending products, and holds certifications spanning AI content workflows, performance advertising, and office administration.
